reviews.t: attachments fall off once the hair dryer is hot
reviews.x: I think the dryer is very good at drying and it is small enough for my short arms. what is problematic is that the attachments fall off once the dryer becomes hot and then the attachment is too hot to the touch to snap it back on. When it is hot it won't snap back on.  This was very disappointing .

reviews.t: A Nice Addition to your Gym Bag
reviews.x: Lightweight and durable. Perfect for on the go from work to gym to home. Would have loved a heat proof protective tote though.
A little large for travel.  Doesn’t fold up but has good power.

However, I recently discovered that there is a lot of new technology in hairdryers which prompted me to purchase this one. I am very pleased. First off, the nozzles really make a difference in how the hair dries. Also, the ceramic and tourmaline ionic technology leave my hair looking much better than it did with the previous hairdryer. The airflow isn't as powerful as I expected, but it does the job.  My biggest complaint and frustration is with the attachments.  I use the diffuser the most and once the soft plastic it's made of gets hot the diffuser will drop off.  You don't even need to bump it before it lets go and falls to the floor. reviews.x: It's ackward to turn the hair dryer on and off during the hair styling process, if you are doing it on your own head. The position of the switch should be where your thumb touches, on the side of the handle (as usual) and not on the back, so you don't  have to turn your hand to turn it on and off. It doesn't flow right. That was the first flaw I noticed.  I've owned this hair dryer for one year now, and I still can't get used to the odd switch position. And I still don't like it. Immediately shut off and now won't turn back on. So sad that I went to use this for the first time after the return window closed so now I'm just stuck with a broken hair dryer. I bought this hairdryer to take on a trip.  I bought it because it was small and had a diffuser feature.  Well, the low setting did not work whatsoever and that is the only setting I can use on my very curly hair.  I would have returned the hairdryer but I threw it in the garbage at my hotel.  No need to haul it around in my suitcase.  I still cannot believe it did not work.  I should have listened to the reviews.

Happy with this little thing. Quiet and small. But strong and drys my hair quickly :)  Update: after a few months of use, this morning the hair dryer got really hot (on its normal low heat setting) and then it went on HI automatically and then all of a sudden, a loud pop! The hair dryer now no longer works :(  Not sure what happened and I put it away and make sure to unplug after every use.

reviews.t: It blew up, don't buy, it's dangerous!
reviews.x: I was really loving this dryer not only for traveling, but everyday use. It's hard to find a good dryer for natural curly hair and this one fit the bill, until it blew up in my hand while I was using it! Thankfully I was uninjured, but I have never had this happen to me and it popped and smoke went everywhere! They should pull this off the market as it is unsafe and could cause injury.

So I’m actually returning this because I used it once only for it to stop working on me. It was working well but after about 15 minutes of me using it the fan suddenly switched to low.... I thought I accidentally hit the wrong thing but then it just stopped altogether. I tried turning it off and then back on again. It worked for like 2 minutes then just switched off again.

reviews.t: Size is great, but it does get hot!
reviews.x: I was happy with the compact size of this hair dryer.  It fits nicely in a bathroom drawer and is easy to pack. The only problem, as has been mentioned in other reviews, is that it gets hot and the attachments don't stay on it.  That can certainly be annoying and you have to be careful not to burn yourself on the attachments when picking them up after they have fallen off!

This hair dryer was the worst product I ever bought from Amazon. Condition was used and returned. It was dirty with crude around nozzle, scratches, lint buildup clogging the intake grill. No additional packaging, just had shipping label on dryer box. Doesn’t deserve one star.  l liked the light weight of dryer and the attachments, but did not try because of condition.

reviews.t: And back it goes - thumbs down!
reviews.x: First time using, the warm setting stopped after about three minutes. Like completely stopped - no fan or anything. Hot and cold worked, but the warm setting - nothing. In addition, the “cool” button sent out a piping hot stream of air! I am giving it two stars instead of one since the size and weight are good for travel. Back to the drawing board!

Is there a way to secure all these parts when in use? I can’t use a masking tape or packaging tapes, right? It might caused a bigger problem! Please help me here!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the dryer as lightweight, compact, and great for travel or everyday use.
A common complaint is that the nozzles and attachments fall off or won't stay on, especially once the dryer gets hot.
Several reviewers report durability problems, with units making rattling noises or quitting entirely after short use.
Reviewers frequently note strong drying power and quick drying despite the small size.
Some reviewers mention the dryer is a bit large for travel or doesn't fold up.
